extension.description: Installs, verifies and updates the Kodi setup.
extension.news: v1.0.10 - Installs Updater before the main FLAM dependency job begins. - Uses script.flam.bundle for one Kodi-managed build installation. - Keeps Updater installed so failed dependency downloads can be retried. - Fixes Android keymap copying and derives the network User-Agent from the installed version.
